title: potentilla glandulosa f. ashlandica
intro: Potentilla glandulosa f. ashlandica, commonly known as Ashland cinquefoil, is a variety of the Potentilla glandulosa plant, which is a flowering perennial native to North America. It has been used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation, promoting wound healing, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ashland cinquefoil include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis, skin irritations, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
